prompt:
TRUE chunky pixel art static asset sheet only. Four 16x16 logical items in an exact 4-column by 1-row grid, rendered large as crisp square Cells, separated by two full magenta #FF00FF logical gutter Cells. Flat magenta #FF00FF keyed background outside the items. No labels, numbers, margins, anti-aliasing, blur, gradients, or dithering.

Subject: the working face of a mine tunnel cut through plain rock. Very dark warm plum-brown stone, near-black in the recesses, lit by neutral upper-left local light with warm shadow. No ore, no crystal, no metal, no gems, no colored veins - this is ordinary rock. Each tile must tile seamlessly with itself top to bottom, with the rock structure continuing across the top and bottom edges without a visible join.

Item 1 "intact": a solid unbroken rock face, subtle strata and tool marks, no damage.
Item 2 "chipped": the same rock with several pale freshly-exposed chip scars where stone has been knocked away, and a few small loose flakes. Clearly worked but structurally whole.
Item 3 "cracked": a branching fracture network runs through the face, with displaced blocks along the cracks and the first small dark voids opening behind them.
Item 4 "crumbling": the face is failing - large dark voids, separated rubble blocks hanging loose, only a broken remnant of the original flat face left.

The four states must be ordered unambiguously by damage using value and silhouette alone, with hue removed. Damage reads as bright freshly-broken stone against dark voids, not as added noise or speckle.

No characters, no tools, no pickaxe, no ore, no crystal, no text, no UI, no borders, no vignette.
